greeting.text: {player}. I have not seen you here before. I am Yuno, of the Golden Dawn.
A new delver. If you are going into the dungeon, go in with a plan. Ask me what you want to know.
Hm. You look like you have not decided whether to be brave or careful. Be both.
So you are the one the guardians keep losing to. I wanted to meet you, {player}.
Still in one piece. That is a good start.

hint.text: My rival would charge in first and think afterwards. I prefer the other order. Both work, if you survive.
Wind never pushes for the sake of pushing. It goes where the resistance is least. Fight the same way.
A spirit lends its strength only to someone it trusts. Treat the one that chose you as a partner, not a tool.
Spirit Dive asks a great deal of you both. Do not stay in it longer than the strain allows.
Mana runs lower down there than it feels. If your magic starts to stutter, step back and breathe before you cast again.
I mean to become Wizard King. So does Asta. Neither of us can afford to lose to anything in this dungeon.
You have not beaten a single champion yet. Start with the Eye of the Midnight Sun on the early floors. They are strong, but they are the first step, not the last.
Read the Chronicle in the plaza before you go down. It shows which fights are open to you and which are not.
You are making progress against the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Do not grow comfortable: the ones who lead them are far beyond the first.
Heath Grice is down? Then you know the Eye's soldiers can be beaten. Remember how you did it.
You brought Vetto down: all brawn and no mercy, and you still found a way. I am impressed.
The Spade Kingdom. The Zogratis name carries a weight the Eye never had: gravity, blood and bone. Prepare for each of them separately.
Lucius Zogratis. Even the Wizard King could not end him alone. Do not enter his arena unless you can fight as a team.
There are fighters in the Chronicle I have never heard of, from worlds I have never seen. I intend to measure myself against every one.

farewell.text: May the wind be at your back.
I will be here when you return. Try to make that certain.
